entry.name: abl.device.drumsampler~
entry.description: A monophonic sampler with various effect processors.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: attack
attributes.description: Sets the time needed to travel from the initial level to the peak level in seconds.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: cutoff
attributes.description: Sets the filter cutoff frequency in Hz.

attributes.name: decay
attributes.description: Sets the amount of time in seconds for the envelope to travel from the peak level to zero.

attributes.name: detune
attributes.description: Sets the global detune amount in cents.

attributes.name: eightbitdecay
attributes.description: Sets the decay time for the internal low-pass filter of the 8-bit effect.

attributes.name: eightbitrate
attributes.description: Sets the sample rate to be used to play back the sample.

attributes.name: envtype
attributes.description: Sets the envelope mode

choices.label: A gated envelope which releases after the note finishes
A triggered envelope which decays after a set hold time

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Enable or disable the filter section

attributes.name: filtertype
attributes.description: Sets the filter type

attributes.name: fm
attributes.description: Sets the amount of frequency modulation applied to the sample.

attributes.name: fmfreq
attributes.description: Sets the frequency used to modulate the sample's pitch. Note that the frequency will be adjusted based on the global pitch controls and the MIDI note played.

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fx
attributes.description: Enable or disable playback effects.

attributes.name: fxtype
attributes.description: Sets the type of playback effect.

attributes.name: gain
attributes.description: Sets the sample gain in dB.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hold
attributes.description: Sets the amount of time in seconds that the amplitude will be kept at the peak level after reaching the attack time. This has no effect when the envelope mode is set to gate.

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ins
attributes.description: Declares additional inlets that can be used to control float-type attributes at either event or signal rate. Any declared attributes already mapped to inlets will be ignored. This attribute can only be set when the object is instantiated.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Sets the length of the sample region that is played, calculated as a percentage of the sample's length.

attributes.name: looplength
attributes.description: Sets the length of the loop. Note that the loop length will be adjusted based on the global pitch controls and the MIDI note played.

attributes.name: loopoffset
attributes.description: Sets the loop start point in relation to the sample start point. Note that the loop offset will be adjusted based on the global pitch controls and MIDI note played.

attributes.name: mod
attributes.description: Sets the modulation amount.

attributes.name: moddst
attributes.description: Sets the modulation target/destination.

attributes.name: modsrc
attributes.description: Sets the modulation source.

attributes.name: noise
attributes.description: Sets the level of the noise oscillator. Note that the oscillator's envelope uses the global attack and decay settings.

attributes.name: noisecolor
attributes.description: Sets the frequency used to filter the noise oscillator. Note that the frequency will be adjusted based on the global pitch controls and the MIDI note played.

attributes.name: pan
attributes.description: Sets the global panning.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: peak
attributes.description: Sets the peak gain in dB for the peak filter.

attributes.name: pitchenv
attributes.description: Sets the amount of pitch modulation applied to the sample. Positive or negative values can be used, resulting in higher or lower pitch, respectively.

attributes.name: pitchenvdecay
attributes.description: Sets the time required for the pitch to go back to the base value as determined by the pitch controls.

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: punch
attributes.description: Sets the amount of ducking applied to the sample.

attributes.name: punchrelease
attributes.description: Sets the time in seconds for the gain reduction to fall back to zero after the initial trigger.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: res
attributes.description: Sets the filter resonance for the lowpass or highpass filter.

attributes.name: rm
attributes.description: Sets the amount of ring modulation applied to the sample.

attributes.name: rmfreq
attributes.description: Sets the frequency used to modulate the sample's amplitude. Low values create a tremolo effect while high values add typical ring modulation artifacts. Note that the frequency will be adjusted based on the global pitch controls and the MIDI note played.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: Sets the sample start point, calculated as a percentage of the sample length.

attributes.name: stretchfactor
attributes.description: Sets the amount of time-stretching as a factor of the original playback speed.

attributes.name: stretchgrain
attributes.description: Sets the the size of the grain (in seconds) used to time-stretch the sample.

attributes.name: subosc
attributes.description: Sets the level of the sub oscillator. Note that the oscillator's envelope uses the global attack and decay settings.

attributes.name: suboscfreq
attributes.description: Sets the sub oscillator frequency. Note that the frequency will be adjusted based on the global pitch controls and the MIDI note played.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: transpose
attributes.description: Sets the global transposition amount in semitones.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: vel
attributes.description: Sets how much the volume will be modulated by incoming MIDI note velocity.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Sets the global volume in dB.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Double click to view associated buffer~
